description.fr-FR: Les opuscules de sainte Jeanne-Françoise de Chantal : le petit traité sur l’oraison, ses réponses sur l’oraison de quiétude, ses conseils de direction à des religieuses et à des supérieures, des fragments du recueil de paroles de saint François de Sales à la Sainte, les paroles consolantes pour tous les jours de l’année recueillies par ses contemporaines, et les points de la vie religieuse expliqués par le saint Fondateur.
description.en-US: The minor writings of St. Jane Frances de Chantal: the short treatise on prayer, her answers on the prayer of quiet, her counsels of direction to religious and superiors, fragments of the collection of St. Francis de Sales’s words to the Saint, the consoling sayings for every day of the year gathered by her contemporaries, and the points of religious life explained by the holy Founder.
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal: o pequeno tratado sobre a oração, suas respostas sobre a oração de quietude, seus conselhos de direção a religiosas e superioras, fragmentos do recolhimento de palavras de são Francisco de Sales à Santa, as palavras consoladoras para todos os dias do ano e os pontos da vida religiosa explicados pelo santo Fundador.

fr-FR.editor: Religieuses du Premier Monastère de la Visitation d’Annecy

sources.edition: Sainte Jeanne-Françoise Frémyot de Chantal, sa vie et ses œuvres, Plon, Paris, 1876, tome III (Œuvres diverses II), pp. 257–541 (Opuscules). Archive.org OCR of the Sainte-Geneviève copy.
sources.description: OCR cleaned by script. Includes the Paroles consolantes (the "Sentences pour tous les jours de l’année"), grouped by subject as in the edition, and two sets of words of Francis de Sales (the Fragments du recueil and Quelques points de la vie religieuse), which are his teaching as recorded by Jane de Chantal.
